findings.claim: Needle is an imported external JAX/Flax SimpleAttentionNetwork project for single-shot function calling/tool-use, not a general conversational model.
findings.implication: Treat as narrow proposal/routing organ candidate, not world-model, memory, GWT, or full cognition.

findings.claim: The attention-only/no-FFN design may be useful for FRANK's cheap action/tool proposal gate because query+tool schema is external structured information.
findings.implication: Candidate path: query/state summary/tool schemas -> ranked proposal JSON with confidence/provenance -> external authority layer decides.

findings.claim: Needle must not become execution authority; output remains a proposed tool call that passes through FRANK capability/commit gateway and ClayCode effect/provenance contract.
findings.implication: Never mutate state, call tools, spend money, or bypass owner/security/capability receipts from Needle output alone.

findings.claim: Needle's local fit for FRANK is unverified; no Project-Frankenstein search match or local benchmark/ablation receipt was found in this invocation.
findings.implication: No exact Level-0 coverage credit or Harness/ClayCode completion credit until local Needle-vs-router validation exists.

proposed_test.title: Needle proposal-gate benchmark for FRANK
proposed_test.method: Create 120+ examples per FRANK tool/capability class plus hard negatives, long-chat summaries, unknown/ambiguous requests and forbidden effects; compare Needle with deterministic/rule router and Qwen-class router on JSON validity, correct tool, args, abstention, latency, CPU/RAM, and malformed-schema recovery.
proposed_test.pass_condition: Latency/cost improves while correct proposal and abstention do not regress; zero direct execution authority.
proposed_test.falsifier: Overcalling, failed abstention, context loss under compressed state, or guard/fine-tune cost exceeding deterministic/router alternatives.

branch_feedback.frank: Use Needle only as bounded action/tool proposal organ.
branch_feedback.claycode: Encode proposal-vs-commit boundary for Needle outputs.
branch_feedback.harness: Add overcall/undercall/ambiguous/forbidden tool tests and recovery receipts.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: Persist Needle proposals as non-authoritative evidence with schema hash, confidence, chosen/overridden outcome and execution receipt.
branch_feedback.claygraph: Represent Needle as organ node linked to proposal edges, not semantic truth.
branch_feedback.gwt: Needle output is pre-workspace candidate selection; ignition requires downstream uptake/outcome evidence.
branch_feedback.emergenz: No emergence credit from routing accuracy alone; require lesion/rescue/effect tests.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: Keep set-valued candidate tools until authority/effect layer resolves.
